g1-implement.title: Populate per-event entity_count + regression test + dof-engagement demonstration
g1-implement.imperative: Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF for this gate and implement. (1) In src/evo_predictor/module_training_orchestration.py evaluate_labeled_batches, set entity_count = len(batch.entity_ids) on the per-event ROW top-level (next to entity_ids), NOT in the metrics dict (avoid polluting aggregate_metrics via _mean_metrics). (2) Add a regression test asserting entity_count is a positive int for every scored event row produced by event_metric_rows / evaluate_labeled_batches, and that it flows through to the calibration dof. (3) Add a unit-level demonstration test that with realistic varying per-event entity counts the calibration's beta*effective_dof term is non-constant across events (dof varies; the fitted calibration responds), guarding against regression to the constant-dof collapse. Run targeted tests with py -m pytest on the relevant subsets only. Run py -m src.utils.simplification_limits on touched paths. Run pyright on touched files if available.

postconditions.statement: IMPLEMENTER_RESULT returned with no unresolved blockers
